name: Stability Ball Crunch
steps: Sit on the ball and walk your feet forward until it supports your middle and lower back.
Plant your feet with knees bent, cross your arms over your chest and let your upper back follow the ball’s curve.
Exhale and contract your abs to curl your rib cage smoothly forward and upward toward your pelvis.
Pause briefly at peak contraction, then lower your shoulders slowly back over the ball into a light stretch.
tips: Keep your hips and the ball still so your abs perform the flexion rather than rolling backward and forward.
Support your head lightly without pulling your chin into your chest.
